Sim-hosted URLs return an empty `204` and v2 JSON errors. Object-storage URLs may return `200` or `201` and provider-specific errors, often XML.

This is the URL's own expiry and is normally earlier than the upload session's expiresAt: the session stays open for later part, status, completion, and abort requests, but the bytes must be uploaded before this time. NonRootFolderPathInput.title: Non-root folder path input
NonRootFolderPathInput.description: Non-root folder path. A missing leading slash is normalized before validation. Segments are percent-encoded, so a folder shown as "New folder" is `/New%20folder`: everything outside `A-Z a-z 0-9 - _ . ~` is escaped as uppercase hex, and only that exact encoding is accepted. A trailing slash, an empty segment, and a literal `.` or `..` segment are rejected. At most 64 segments and 4096 encoded bytes.

V2KnowledgeBase.title: Knowledge base
V2KnowledgeBase.description: A collection of documents indexed for vector and tag search.

workspaceId.description: Workspace that owns the knowledge bases.

knowledgeBaseIds.description: One knowledge base ID or an array of up to 20 IDs. Query searches require the same embedding model and dimensions across all selected bases; search incompatible bases separately. Tag-only searches do not require this.

query.description: Natural-language query; required when tag filters are omitted. At most 32768 characters — longer text exceeds the embedding model's per-input token ceiling and would be truncated before the billed search ran.
examples: How do I reset my password?

topK.description: Maximum number of search results to return. Must be a whole number between 1 and 100.

tagFilters.description: Up to 10 filters combined with AND; repeating a tag narrows results. To express OR, run separate searches. Every tag must exist with the same slot and field type in each selected knowledge base or the request is rejected. List valid names with the knowledge-base tag-list operation.

searchMode.description: Retrieval strategy: `vector` uses semantic search; `hybrid` also runs full-text search. Omit to use the workspace policy.

rerankerEnabled.description: Reorder retrieved chunks with a reranking model before truncating to `topK`. Ignored for tag-only searches. A completed reranking call adds a search unit. If reranking is unavailable, results keep their retrieval order; check `rerankerStatus`.

rerankerModel.description: Reranking model to use when `rerankerEnabled` is true. Defaults to `rerank-v4.0-fast`.

rerankerInputCount.description: How many candidate chunks to retrieve before reranking. Defaults to four times `topK`, capped at 100. A larger pool costs more retrieval work but gives the reranker more to choose from.

tagName.description: Display name of the tag to filter.

operator.description: Comparison operator; valid operators depend on the field type. Text tags accept eq, neq, contains, not_contains, starts_with, ends_with; number and date tags accept eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, between; boolean tags accept eq, neq. An operator the tag's field type does not implement is rejected, never ignored.

valueTo.description: Upper bound for the `between` operator, and required whenever that operator is used.

V2KnowledgeSearchTagFilter.title: Knowledge search tag filter
V2KnowledgeSearchTagFilter.description: A structured tag filter applied to knowledge search.

knowledgeBaseId.description: Knowledge base the matching chunk came from; a search may span up to 20.

documentId.description: Identifier of the document containing the matching chunk.

documentName.description: Filename of the source document, or null when unavailable.

sourceUrl.description: Original source URL, or null for a directly uploaded document.

content.description: Text content of the matching chunk.
examples: To reset your password, open Settings and choose Security.

chunkIndex.description: Zero-based chunk index within the document.

additionalProperties.description: User-defined string, number, boolean, or date tag value.

metadata.description: Document tag values keyed by tag display name.

similarity.description: Cosine similarity between the query embedding and the chunk (1 - cosine distance), reported the same way in `vector` and `hybrid` mode; tag-only matches use 1. In `hybrid` mode results are not ordered by this value — see `rankScore`.

rankScore.description: The retrieval score, or reranker score when reranked. In `vector` mode it equals `similarity`; in `hybrid` mode it is the reciprocal-rank-fusion score (a sum of 1/(60 + rank) over the lexical and vector legs, so a chunk both legs ranked first scores 2/61); when a reranker ordered the results it is `rerankerScore`. Recency boosting may reorder retrieval results without changing this score; `rank` always reflects returned order.

rerankerScore.description: Relevance score assigned by the reranker, present only on results a reranker ordered. Results are ordered by this score when it is present, which is why it can disagree with `similarity`.

V2KnowledgeSearchResult.title: Knowledge search result
V2KnowledgeSearchResult.description: A matching document chunk returned by knowledge search.

query.description: Executed query, or an empty string for tag-only search.
examples: How do I reset my password?

knowledgeBaseIds.description: Knowledge base identifiers that were searched.

rerankerStatus.description: Reranking outcome. `applied` means results carry `rerankerScore` and follow that score. `unavailable` means reranking could not produce a usable order; the search succeeded in retrieval order without `rerankerScore`. Retry if reranking is needed. `skipped` means there was nothing to rank. `not_requested` means `rerankerEnabled` was absent or false.
